cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that certificate out of the frame. My name goes under 'cake design' before I give it the final look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you designed it. Can't I seal it now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once the next members can know it too. Fill that blank; I'll check the spelling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team. They did work on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then list us all, with what each did. I'll get the names; you leave the frame open. We'll give everyone a line, and I'll check mine alongside theirs before you seal it.
